visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a person in a grey shirt seated at a table covered with a white tablecloth. (2) A extreme close-up focuses on a platter of grilled lobster halves, garnished with green herbs. A pair of metal tongs lifts a piece of succulent lobster meat, revealing bright red lobster roe and creamy green liver tucked inside the shell. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the seafood. (3) The camera shifts to a close-up of a thick steak topped with a piece of foie gras, served with broccoli and mushrooms. A fork lifts the foie gras and then slices into the steak, showing a pink, medium-rare center with juices glistening under the restaurant lights. (4) A large tomahawk pork chop is presented on a white plate with roasted mushrooms and broccoli. A hand uses a knife and fork to cut a cross-section of the pork, displaying layers of lean meat and fat with a slight pinkish hue, indicating its tenderness. (5) Various side dishes are shown: a small white cup of truffle steamed egg being scooped with a spoon, a basket containing two round, crusty French breads being torn open to reveal a soft interior, and two different salads featuring salmon and large shrimp. (6) Dessert follows with a close-up of a creme brulee being cracked by a spoon and a chocolate lava cake where molten chocolate flows out as it is cut. An iced drink in a clear glass is placed on the table. (7) The final sequence shows the restaurant's elegant dining rooms with red velvet wall panels and a large private table set for a group. The video ends with a shot of the restaurant's exterior entrance, featuring a wooden sign and glass doors.
